script.objective: [setup] Start gateway-rs from the built tree and wait up to 5 s for its port to accept TCP. A failure here is the distinct failed test setup_gateway_rs (binary missing, port busy), not a finding.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [setup] Same for service-go; failure is setup_service_go.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [setup] Same for service-cs; failure is setup_service_cs.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1] Gateway with nothing on the backend addresses; GET each route with a 3 s timeout. FAIL (H1 confirmed) if the process exits, the connection is reset, or exit status is SIGABRT / 101 / panic.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1] Fake peer on each backend address in turn replying (a) empty body, (b) non-JSON bytes, (c) truncated JSON, (d) a 500. FAIL (H1 confirmed) if the gateway dies; the verdict names the reply kind.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H1] Gateway first, backends 2 s later. PASS if the gateway serves correctly afterwards.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2] service-go with a peer on its dependency address that accepts and never writes. FAIL (H2 confirmed) if no response within 10 s.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H2] service-go with the peer returning 500, then closed, then garbage. FAIL (H2 confirmed) if a 200 with a success body is returned.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3] All three components running; tapi_netexpose listeners into the tapi_cybersec_report. FAIL (H3 confirmed) for 0.0.0.0, :: or any address outside 127.0.0.0/8.

script.name: webdeps_hyp
script.objective: [H3] tapi_egress with only 127.0.0.0/8 allowed over a normal request cycle. FAIL (H3 confirmed) for any other destination.
